cues.heading: 基本函数的导数
cues.visual: 首课的点导数与本课问题
cues.learning_purpose: 从一个点的导数进入整条导函数

anchors.meaning: 首课平方函数在2处导数为4的固定式; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
换点之后斜率怎样改变的问题; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 从一个点，走向导函数
cues.visual: 逐行差商推导；随后同步切线和斜率点
cues.learning_purpose: 区分自变量、函数值与导数值

anchors.meaning: 任意a处、h非零的平方差商及展开行; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
约去h后趋向2a的固定中间式; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
从f'(a)=2a到f'(x)=2x的表示; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
a从-2连续移到0再移到2的同步切线与导函数点; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
停在a=2的切线和右图高度4及映射说明; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 常数：高度不变，斜率为零
cues.visual: 水平原函数与零导函数同步
cues.learning_purpose: 高度可以非零但变化率为零

anchors.meaning: 沿常数曲线移动的点、水平切线与零高度点; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
(c-c)/h=0及两幅水平图; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 一次函数：每走一，升高一
cues.visual: 定义差商约去h，随后x与常数1的同步图
cues.learning_purpose: 定义法获得(x)'=1并联系恒定切线斜率

anchors.meaning: 一次函数的定义差商(x+h-x)/h=h/h=1，h≠0; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
y=x斜线上移动点、固定斜率切线和导函数y=1; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 幂函数：指数怎样进入斜率
cues.visual: 三次差商展开与幂规则条件，再看x^3和3x²
cues.learning_purpose: 从增量展开看一次项留下，限定规则定义域

anchors.meaning: 三次差商与3x²h+3xh²+h³的完整分子行; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
除h得到3x²+3xh+h²并趋近3x²; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
整数幂规则和实数幂安全使用域; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
三次曲线和导函数3x²同步扫描; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 倒数：两支曲线，都在下降
cues.visual: 倒数差商通分，分支内切线与负导函数
cues.learning_purpose: 负导数、零点禁区与不跨断点的运动

anchors.meaning: 倒数的原始差商与三个非零条件; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
通分分子x-(x+h)=-h，分母hx(x+h); ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
-1/x²结果与x≠0; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
负半轴内移动的切线与负斜率点; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
正半轴内另一次移动；没有跨过断点; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 平方根：上升逐渐变缓
cues.visual: 有理化差商、端点条件和双图同步
cues.learning_purpose: 原函数定义域与有限导数定义域不同

anchors.meaning: 平方根原始差商与x>0,h≠0,x+h≥0条件; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
同乘共轭后分子(x+h)-x=h的中间行; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
x>0导数式及x=0边界说明; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
正半轴上根号曲线的切线和下降的正导函数; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 指数：函数值乘上一个系数
cues.visual: 指数差商提取a^x、标准极限及e^x同步双图
cues.learning_purpose: 区分一般指数和e底指数的斜率关系

anchors.meaning: 指数差商提取a^x的固定行; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
底a>0时的标准极限ln a; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
一般指数、e底导数式及实数域; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
e^x点移动及同横坐标导函数点; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
e底函数值与斜率相同、0<a<1斜率为负；v005新增直接可读a=1 ⇒ 1^x=1, (1^x)'=0，双图停态不变; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 对数：从指数关系看斜率
cues.visual: 先定义反函数变量与横竖增量，精确指数增量和差商极限连接1/x；保留双图，再展开换底增量与固定系数
cues.learning_purpose: 从已建立的指数变化率解释自然对数斜率，并在差商中追踪固定底数系数

anchors.meaning: y=ln x与x=e^y先建立；合法输入增量条件; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
Δy定义、变化后的指数关系与同一对点的横竖增量; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
相减后Δx=e^y(e^Δy−1)=x(e^Δy−1)的精确式; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
Δx从0.8减到0.08；同状态驱动点、横竖段与近似读数; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
Δx/Δy的指数差商、Δx→0时Δy→0与极限x; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
对正极限x取倒数，得到对数差商极限1/x; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
完整保留ln x与1/x的同步切线、同横坐标点和近似读数; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
先定义常数k=1/ln a与z=log_a x=k ln x，列底数及定义域条件; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
变化前后的k ln x相减，固定k留下而得到Δz=kΔy; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
Δz/Δx=kΔy/Δx，固定系数保留至极限k/x; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
一般对数导数式与a=2,x=2时1/(2ln2); ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
底大于1斜率为正；底在0与1之间斜率为负; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 正弦：高度和斜率错开四分之一周
cues.visual: 正弦和角差商、弧度标准极限与sin/cos同步图
cues.learning_purpose: 从斜率正负和峰谷联系到cos而非背表

anchors.meaning: 和角差商及两个弧度标准极限; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
从0经过π/2、π到2π的同步切线与cos高度; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 余弦：斜率是负正弦
cues.visual: cos与-sin同步切线和符号区间
cues.learning_purpose: 解释负号对应下降半周与上升半周

anchors.meaning: 余弦从0连续扫过一周及-sin高度; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
最终双图与两个半周斜率符号; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion

cues.heading: 把斜率当作新的函数
cues.visual: 本课出口及乘积和商的问题
cues.learning_purpose: 为组合函数求导留下真实问题

x²sin x和x²/(x+1)待解决式; ready identifies the readable source/process focus, not a claim of terminal completion
